This is a list of earthquakes in 2013. Only earthquakes of magnitude 6 or above are included, unless they result in damage and/or casualties, or are notable for some other reason. All dates are listed according to UTC time. This year was quite busy with 17 events above magnitude 7 and two above magnitude 8, in Kamchatka and Santa Cruz Islands. Deadly quakes struck Pakistan, Philippines, China and Iran.

  • A magnitude 7.5 earthquake struck off the coast of southeast Alaska on January 5 at a depth of 9.9 km (6.2 mi).[3]
  • A magnitude 5.4 earthquake struck Western Iran on January 12 at a depth of 4.1 km (2.5 mi).[4] One person injured and many homes damaged in the Boldaji area.[5]
  • A magnitude 6.1 earthquake struck the Pacific-Antarctic Ridge on January 15 at a depth of 10 km (6.2 mi).[6]
  • A magnitude 5.4 earthquake struck Qinghai, China on January 18 at a depth of 8.0 km (5.0 mi).[7] One person injured and 3,000 buildings damaged near the epicenter.[8]
  • A magnitude 6.1 earthquake struck northern Sumatra, on January 21 at depth of 12 km (7.5 mi), killing one person, injuring 15 others, and damaging 71 buildings.[9]
  • A magnitude 6.1 earthquake struck Kegen, Kazakhstan on January 28 at a depth of 10 km (6.2 mi).[10] No damage was reported in Kazakhstan, but at least 156 houses were destroyed and 636 others were damaged in Kyrgyzstan,[11] while in Xinjiang, China, 216 houses collapsed and 7,458 buildings were damaged.[11][12]
  • A magnitude 6.8 earthquake struck north-central Chile on January 30 at a depth of 45.7 km (28.4 mi).[13] One person died of a heart attack, windows broke, rockfalls occurred and some walls were damaged or collapsed in Vallenar and in Copiapo.[14]
  • A magnitude 6.0 earthquake struck the Santa Cruz Islands on January 30 at a depth of 10 km (6.2 mi).[15]
  • A magnitude 6.2 earthquake struck the Santa Cruz Islands on January 31 at a depth of 9.2 km (5.7 mi).[16]

  • A magnitude 6.0 earthquake struck Japan on April 1 at a depth of 12.5 km (7.8 mi).[63]

  • A magnitude 6.3 earthquake struck Russia on April 5 at a depth of 561.9 km (349.1 mi).[66]
  • A magnitude 7.0 earthquake struck Papua on April 6 at a depth of 66 km (41 mi).[67] Three people were killed by landslides in Tolikara Regency.[68]
  • A magnitude 6.3 earthquake struck Iran on April 9 at a depth of 10 km (6.2 mi), killing at least 35 people and injuring 850 others.[69][70]
  • A magnitude 5.4 earthquake struck Iran on April 10 at a depth of 15.0 km (9.3 mi).[71] Four people injured and some buildings previously damaged by the event in April 9 were destroyed.[72]
  • A magnitude 5.4 earthquake struck Honduras on April 10 at a depth of 3.5 km (2.2 mi). A total of 12 houses were destroyed and 66 others, along with two schools, were damaged. 43 people were evacuated.[73][46]
  • A magnitude 5.8 earthquake struck Japan on April 12 at a depth of 14.0 km (8.7 mi).[74] At least 28 people were injured, 450 houses were damaged and items falling off shelves in stores were reported.[46][75]
  • A magnitude 6.0 earthquake struck Vanuatu on April 13 at a depth of 270.7 km (168.2 mi).[76]
  • A magnitude 6.6 earthquake struck Papua New Guinea on April 14 at a depth of 35.3 km (21.9 mi).[77]
  • A magnitude 4.4 earthquake struck India on April 16 at a depth of 43.8 km (27.2 mi).[78] One person killed and two injured by a mudslide in the Kalgachia area.[79]
  • A magnitude 7.7 earthquake struck Iran on April 16 at a depth of 82 km (51 mi).[80] According to Pakistani authorities, 39 people lost their lives in the Panjgur and Mashkeel areas of Balochistan Province, which borders Iran. One fatality was reported from Iran, while a total of 117 were injured across the two countries.[81]
  • A magnitude 6.6 earthquake struck Papua New Guinea on April 16 at a depth of 13 km (8.1 mi).[82]
  • A magnitude 5.1 earthquake struck Yunnan on April 17 at a depth of 38.3 km (23.8 mi). Nine people were injured, 276 homes destroyed and many others damaged and more than 12,000 people were evacuated.[83][84]
  • A magnitude 5.6 earthquake struck Japan on April 17 at a depth of 8.8 km (5.5 mi). Three people were injured, some buildings damaged and landslides blocked roads in the Miyakejima area.[85][86]
  • A magnitude 5.9 earthquake struck Japan on April 17 at a depth of 50.5 km (31.4 mi). Two people were injured.[87][88]
  • A magnitude 7.2 earthquake struck the Kuril Islands on April 19 at a depth of 122.3 km (76.0 mi).[89]
  • A magnitude 6.0 earthquake struck south of the Kuril Islands on April 19 at a depth of 18.6 km (11.6 mi).[90]
  • A magnitude 4.8 earthquake struck East Azerbaijan province on April 18 at a depth of 10.3 km (6.4 mi). Three people were injured in the epicentral area.[91][92]
  • A magnitude 4.8 earthquake struck Central Java on April 19 at a depth of 9.9 km (6.2 mi).[93] Two people were injured, 34 homes collapsed, 277 others and at least nine buildings damaged and 5,000 people displaced in Banjarnegara Regency.[94]
  • A magnitude 6.6 earthquake struck Western Sichuan on April 20 at a depth of 12.3 km (7.6 mi). Over 193 people were killed, 24 are missing, and at least 12,211 were injured, more than 968 of them seriously.[95][96][97][98][99]
  • A magnitude 4.8 earthquake struck Uganda on April 20 at a depth of 10.0 km (6.2 mi). Three homes destroyed in Kibaale District.[100][101]
  • A magnitude 6.1 earthquake struck the Kuril Islands on April 20 at a depth of 20.2 km (12.6 mi).[102]
  • A magnitude 6.1 earthquake struck Japan on April 21 at a depth of 424.1 km (263.5 mi).[103]
  • A magnitude 6.0 earthquake struck western Mexico on April 21 at a depth of 70 km (43 mi).[104] Several homes, a school, a church, and two walkways damaged in Las Guacamayas.[105] Power outages also occurred in Mexico City.[106]
  • A magnitude 5.0 earthquake struck China on April 22 at a depth of 27.5 km (17.1 mi). Twelve people injured, nine homes collapsed and 4,012 others were damaged.[107][108]
  • A magnitude 4.4 earthquake struck Hungary on April 22 at a depth of 13.0 km (8.1 mi). Over 4,500 buildings were damaged in the epicentral area, with total losses estimated at $1.5 million.[109][110]
  • A magnitude 6.5 earthquake struck Papua New Guinea on April 23 at a depth of 16.3 km (10.1 mi).[111]
  • A magnitude 4.8 earthquake struck Honduras on April 24 at a depth of 10.0 km (6.2 mi). Six people injured, 12 homes destroyed and 580 others were damaged.[112][113]
  • A magnitude 4.5 earthquake struck Iran on April 24 at a depth of 21.3 km (13.2 mi). Three people injured and several homes were damaged in the Golpayegan area.[114][115]
  • A magnitude 5.6 earthquake struck Afghanistan on April 24 at a depth of 40 miles with an epicentre 11 km (6.8 mi) from Mehtar Lam, the capital of the province, 18 people were killed in the tremors and more than 100 were injured.[116][117]
  • A magnitude 5.3 earthquake struck Sichuan on April 24 at a depth of 10.0 km (6.2 mi). One person killed, 72 injured and 29,092 homes damaged or destroyed in the Yibin area.[118][119]
  • A magnitude 6.2 earthquake struck the Kermadec Islands on April 26 at a depth of 349.0 km (216.9 mi).[120]

  • A magnitude 5.7 earthquake struck Jammu and Kashmir, India on May 1 at a depth of 15.0 km (9.3 mi).[121] Three people killed, including two by landslides, 90 others injured, 1,200 houses destroyed and 68,800 others damaged in the Doda-Kishtwar area.[122][123]
  • A magnitude 4.2 earthquake struck Mostaganem Province, Algeria on May 2 at a depth of 17.3 km (10.7 mi).[124] Seventeen people injured and several buildings were damaged.[125]
  • A magnitude 6.1 earthquake struck the Strait of Hormuz, Iran on May 11 at a depth of 14 km (8.7 mi).[126] Two people, including one child died, 20 others injured, and 70 percent of homes destroyed in 31 villages near the epicenter.[127][128][129]
  • A magnitude 6.4 earthquake struck Tonga on May 11 at a depth of 205.4 km (127.6 mi).[130]
  • A magnitude 4.4 earthquake struck the Fars province, Iran on May 12 at a depth of 14.1 km (8.8 mi).[131] Twelve people injured, five of them seriously, in the Shiraz area.[132]
  • A magnitude 6.8 earthquake struck the Northern Mariana Islands on May 14 at a depth of 601.8 km (373.9 mi).[133]
  • A magnitude 4.7 earthquake struck Jammu and Kashmir, India on May 14 at a depth of 48.0 km (29.8 mi).[134] One person died of a heart attack while evacuating.[135]
  • A magnitude 6.0 earthquake struck offshore Fukushima, Japan on May 18 at a depth of 34 km (21 mi).[136]
  • A magnitude 5.0 earthquake struck Algeria, on May 19 at a depth of 10.0 km (6.2 mi).[137] Five people injured and some homes damaged in the Béjaïa area.[138]
  • A magnitude 6.4 earthquake struck Aysén, Chile on May 20 at a depth of 10.0 km (6.2 mi).[139]
  • A magnitude 6.0 earthquake struck Kamchatka, Russia on May 21 at a depth of 15.1 km (9.4 mi).[140]

  • A magnitude 6.3 earthquake struck Tonga on May 23 at a depth of 154.1 km (95.8 mi).[143]
  • A magnitude 8.3 earthquake struck the Sea of Okhotsk, Russia on May 24 at a depth of 608.9 km (378.4 mi).[144] At least seventeen buildings were damaged in Samara, one of them severely.[citation needed] It was felt 4,000 miles (6,400 km) away in Moscow and as far away as Serbia.[145]
  • A magnitude 5.3 earthquake struck Uzbekistan, on May 24 at a depth of 19.2 km (11.9 mi).[146] Several people injured and several buildings destroyed in the Toy-Tepa area.[147]
  • A magnitude 6.7 earthquake struck the Sea of Okhotsk, Russia on May 24 at a depth of 623.0 km (387.1 mi).[148]
  • A magnitude 5.0 earthquake struck Algeria, on May 26 at a depth of 10.0 km (6.2 mi).[149] Two people injured and several homes and buildings including a mosque damaged in the Béjaïa area.[150]

  • A magnitude 5.6 earthquake struck the Philippines, on June 1 at a depth of 10.0 km (6.2 mi).[151] Thirty-three people injured, 61 homes destroyed, 227 others, 69 buildings and two bridges damaged in the Carmen area.[152][153]
  • A magnitude 6.2 earthquake struck Taiwan, on June 2 at a depth of 20.0 km (12.4 mi), killing 4 people including a mountain climber by falling rocks.[154][153][155][156]
  • A magnitude 6.1 earthquake struck the Solomon Islands, on June 5 at a depth of 64.7 km (40.2 mi).[157]
  • A magnitude 6.7 earthquake struck 176 km (109 mi) east of Christmas Island, on June 13 at a depth of 9.7 km (6.0 mi).[158]
  • A magnitude 6.0 earthquake struck the Kermadec Islands, New Zealand on June 15 at a depth of 172.4 km (107.1 mi).[159]
  • A magnitude 6.2 earthquake struck offshore Crete, Greece, on June 15 at a depth of 10.0 km (6.2 mi).[160]
  • A magnitude 6.5 earthquake struck Nicaragua, on June 15 at a depth of 35.8 km (22.2 mi).[161] One person died of a heart attack, another person injured, six homes and several buildings were damaged, and telephone outages occurred in León, Chinandega, and Managua departments.[162][163]
  • A magnitude 5.8 earthquake struck Mexico, on June 16 at a depth of 52.0 km (32.3 mi).[164] Two people injured, six homes and a hospital damaged in Huitzuco de los Figueroa; ten homes damaged by landslides and 25 people evacuated in Emiliano Zapata; one home and an auditorium damaged in Chilpancingo; two homes damaged in Iguala and Jiutepec; one mall and some homes damaged in Cuernavaca; one church damaged in Taxco. Power outages occurred in Mexico City. Many landslides blocked roads in the epicentral area.[165][166]
  • A magnitude 5.6 earthquake struck Russia, on June 18 at a depth of 9.9 km (6.2 mi).[167] At least 5,950 buildings were damaged, 350 of them severely.[168]
  • A magnitude 4.3 earthquake struck China, on June 22 at a depth of 10.6 km (6.6 mi).[169] Four houses collapsed and 155 others were damaged.[170]
  • A magnitude 5.2 earthquake struck Italy, on June 21 at a depth of 5.1 km (3.2 mi).[171] Four people injured, many buildings damaged and 1,000 people displaced across Tuscany, Emilia-Romagna and Liguria.[172][173]
  • A magnitude 5.1 earthquake struck Indonesia, on June 22 at a depth of 46.5 km (28.9 mi).[174] At least 49 people injured and 5,288 homes damaged in the North Lombok Regency.[175]
  • A magnitude 4.7 earthquake struck Italy, on June 23 at a depth of 10.1 km (6.3 mi).[176] Four people injured, several buildings affected by the 5.2 event in June 21 were destroyed and landslides occurred in the epicentral area.[177][178]
  • A magnitude 6.6 earthquake struck the Mid-Atlantic Ridge, on June 24 at a depth of 10.0 km (6.2 mi).[179]
  • A magnitude 5.0 earthquake struck Nepal, on June 28 at a depth of 24.8 km (15.4 mi).[180] At least 20 people injured and 14 homes damaged in Rukum District.[181]

  • A magnitude 4.8 earthquake struck Algeria, on July 17 at a depth of 9.8 km (6.1 mi).[198] At least 24 people injured and 90 percent of houses were damaged in the Hammam Melouane area.[199][200]
  • A magnitude 4.7 earthquake struck China on July 18 at a depth of 39.4 km (24.5 mi). One person injured and some houses damaged in Lushui County.[201][202]
  • A magnitude 6.5 earthquake struck 20 km (12 mi) east of Seddon, New Zealand on July 21 at a depth of 17 km (11 mi).[203][204] The earthquake was preceded by a series of foreshocks, including a 5.7 and 5.8.[205][206] Four people were injured in Wellington 55 km (34 mi) away.[207]
  • A magnitude 5.9 earthquake struck southeastern Gansu, China on July 21 at a depth of 9.8 km (6.1 mi).[208] At least 95 people were killed and more than 1,000 others injured, with more than 9,000 houses collapsing.[209]
  • A magnitude 6.1 earthquake struck the southwestern Indian Ocean, off of Marion Island in the Prince Edward Islands group, on July 22 at a depth of 10.0 km (6.2 mi).[210]
  • A magnitude 4.7 earthquake struck Peru on July 25 at a depth of 18.8 km (11.7 mi). At least three homes destroyed and several others and a school were damaged in Huambo District.[211][212]
  • A magnitude 6.1 earthquake struck Vanuatu, on July 26 at a depth of 132.6 km (82.4 mi).[213]
  • A magnitude 6.2 earthquake struck South Georgia and the South Sandwich Islands, on July 26 at a depth of 10.0 km (6.2 mi).[214]
  • A magnitude 4.6 earthquake struck Gansu, China on July 28 at a depth of 15.0 km (9.3 mi). Thirty-four people injured, 1,124 houses destroyed, 34,630 others damaged, utilities disrupted and many landslides blocked roads in Wen County.[215][216]

  • A magnitude 6.6 earthquake struck Seddon, New Zealand, 70 km (43 mi) south west of the capital Wellington, on August 16 at a depth of 8 km (5 mi).[229] The USGS, however, listed this quake as 6.5.[230] Five people were injured and widespread damage was reported.[231]
  • A magnitude 5.2 earthquake struck Mexico, on August 16 at a depth of 21.0 km (13.0 mi).[232] Two people injured and one building collapsed in Mexico City.[233]

  • A magnitude 6.1 earthquake struck northwest of Raoul Island, New Zealand, on August 28 at a depth of 488.6 km (303.6 mi).[238]
  • A magnitude 7.0 earthquake struck the Aleutian Islands, Alaska, on August 30 at a depth of 33.5 km (20.8 mi).[239]
  • A magnitude 5.2 earthquake struck Yunnan, China, on August 27 at a depth of 10.0 km (6.2 mi).[240] More than 72 homes damaged or destroyed and 4,000 people affected in the Benzilan area. This is a foreshock of the 5.8 event three days later.[241]
  • A magnitude 4.8 earthquake struck Colombia, on August 27 at a depth of 81.1 km (50.4 mi).[242] Two homes destroyed, 18 others and two schools damaged in the Dagua area.[243]
  • A magnitude 5.8 earthquake struck Yunnan, China, on August 31 at a depth of 9.8 km (6.1 mi). Five people were killed, 24 others were injured, 600 homes destroyed, 55,500 others were damaged, and landslides were reported in the epicenter area.[244][245][246][247]
